result: Added a source-agnostic SQLite membership-index builder that consumes normalized training records incrementally in bounded batches, binds the index to source-file SHA256 and comparison protocol identities, supports exact-fingerprint lookup and composition/site-count prefiltering for near-duplicate checks, and fails closed by deleting partial indices. Frozen immutable sAlex source metadata while leaving archive byte identity unresolved; production membership indices and exposure-audit execution remain unauthorized.
